title: Handle refusal and logprobs events in OpenAI chat streaming

files.patch:
@@ -7,6 +7,15 @@ and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0
 
 ## [Unreleased]
 
+### Fixed
+
+- **A streamed OpenAI Chat refusal, or a stream with logprobs, no longer
+  raises.** The openai gem's chat stream emits `refusal.delta` and
+  `refusal.done` when the model refuses, and `logprobs.*` events when the
+  request sets `logprobs`, and the Chat provider failed on them with
+  `Unexpected Response Event Type`. They are now handled, and `refusal.done`
+  ends the generation, since a refused message never gets a `content.done`.
+
 ## [1.9.1] - 2026-10-16
 
 Releases `activeagent` and `actionagent` 1.9.1, with the matching browser

             # => {type: :"tool_calls.function.arguments.delta", name: "get_current_weather", index: 0, arguments: "", parsed: nil, arguments_delta: ""}
           when :"tool_calls.function.arguments.done"
             # => => {type: :"tool_calls.function.arguments.done", index: 0, name: "get_current_weather", arguments: "{\"location\":\"Boston, MA\"}", parsed: nil}
+          when :"refusal.delta"
+            # No-Op; the refusal is merged into the message from the :chunk event
+          when :"refusal.done"
+            # A refused message ends here, with no content.done
+            self.stream_completion_pending = true
+          when :"logprobs.content.delta", :"logprobs.content.done", :"logprobs.refusal.delta", :"logprobs.refusal.done"
+            # No-Op; sent when the request asks for logprobs
           else
             fail "Unexpected Response Event Type: #{api_response_event.type}"
           end

@@ -44,6 +44,42 @@ def deep_to_h
         MockChunkEvent = Struct.new(:type, :chunk, keyword_init: true)
         MockContentDoneEvent = Struct.new(:type, :content, :parsed, keyword_init: true)
 
+        test "process_stream_chunk handles refusal events and completes on refusal.done" do
+          [
+            ::OpenAI::Helpers::Streaming::ChatRefusalDeltaEvent.new(
+              type: :"refusal.delta", delta: "I can't help with that.", snapshot: "I can't help with that."
+            ),
+            ::OpenAI::Helpers::Streaming::ChatRefusalDoneEvent.new(
+              type: :"refusal.done", refusal: "I can't help with that."
+            )
+          ].each do |event|
+            assert_nothing_raised { @provider.send(:process_stream_chunk, event) }
+          end
+
+          # A refused message has no content.done, so refusal.done must end it
+          assert @provider.send(:stream_completion_pending)
+        end
+
+        test "process_stream_chunk handles logprobs events" do
+          logprob = { token: "Hi", logprob: -0.1, bytes: [ 72, 105 ], top_logprobs: [] }
+          [
+            ::OpenAI::Helpers::Streaming::ChatLogprobsContentDeltaEvent.new(
+              type: :"logprobs.content.delta", content: [ logprob ], snapshot: [ logprob ]
+            ),
+            ::OpenAI::Helpers::Streaming::ChatLogprobsContentDoneEvent.new(
+              type: :"logprobs.content.done", content: [ logprob ]
+            ),
+            ::OpenAI::Helpers::Streaming::ChatLogprobsRefusalDeltaEvent.new(
+              type: :"logprobs.refusal.delta", refusal: [ logprob ], snapshot: [ logprob ]
+            ),
+            ::OpenAI::Helpers::Streaming::ChatLogprobsRefusalDoneEvent.new(
+              type: :"logprobs.refusal.done", refusal: [ logprob ]
+            )
+          ].each do |event|
+            assert_nothing_raised { @provider.send(:process_stream_chunk, event) }
+          end
+        end
+
         test "process_stream_chunk emits :open event on first chunk" do
           chunk = MockChunk.new(
             choices: [ MockChoice.new(index: 0, delta: MockDelta.new(content: "Hi", role: "assistant")) ]
